sources.title: Aprender com intervalos
sources.text: This synthetic handbook examines recall and spacing.

sources.title: Recuperação ativa
sources.text: In this fictional classroom comparison, retrieving before rereading improved next-week recall. The exercise used low-stakes questions and feedback.

sources.title: Intervalos e retenção
sources.text: This invented study compares spaced and massed practice in the same fictional classroom.

sources.title: Resultados
sources.text: In the fictional comparison, practice spread across three days improved next-week recall compared with one massed session. Feedback was available in both groups.

sources.title: Releitura antes da recuperação
sources.text: In a fictional replication with the same classroom conditions, low-stakes questions and feedback, retrieving before rereading did not improve next-week recall. The earlier positive finding was not reproduced.

sources.title: Minha interpretação
sources.text: I prefer short study sessions. This is my preference, not proof that shorter sessions improve retention.

sources.title: Registro de estudo
sources.text: Today I tried three short study sessions. I felt less tired; I did not measure retention.

sources.title: Resultados
sources.text: This fictional editorial distinguishes perceived fluency from measured retention.
